name: Similarweb
description: Research any website or app using Similarweb's market intelligence data. Analyze competitor traffic, uncover top keywords, explore audience demographics, and benchmark performance across industries—all through simple prompts. Ask things like "Show me Nike's traffic sources breakdown" or "What keywords is Adidas ranking for?" and get real-time insights without switching tools. Whether you're a marketer, analyst, investor, or strategist, Similarweb helps you turn competitive questions into answers instantly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Similarweb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Similarweb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.similarweb.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Similarweb MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Similarweb lists 22 MCP tools, including get-websites-traffic-and-engagement, get-websites-traffic-sources, get-websites-website-rank, get-website-content-subdomains-agg, get-websites-similar-sites-agg, get-websites-referrals-agg, get-websites-audience-interests-agg, get-websites-audience-overlap-agg, get-websites-deduplicated-audience, get-pages-leading-folders-agg, get-pages-popular-pages-agg, and get-websites-ppc-spend.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Similarweb?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Similarweb in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Similarweb requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Similarweb is developed by Similarweb. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
